product_metadata.title: 8x10 White Wood Picture Frame with 2 Mats -2 PCS - Displays 5x7 Photos with Mat or 8x10 without Mat - High Definition Glass-Display Documents Diplomas for Wall or Tabletop (White, 8x10)
features: Classic Style and Design: Classic white 8x10 inch picture frame add charming to your any office, family room, living room, or bedroom, perfect for your favorite posters.

Use and Display: Our frames come with one mat and fits two different picture sizes. Perfect for 5x7 inch pictures with mat, or 8x10 inch without mat. Easy to open tabs for easy customization and removable back panel.
Superior Material: High quality wood frame with a smooth white finish and thick and high definition glass front.

Perfect Wall Décor: Mount on the wall, or use the kickstand to set on a table, armoire, nightstand, or dresser. Enhance your space by decorating with three different photo sizes, best memories, and wall art.
Multiple Uses: Makes for an elegant gift and is also ideal for DIY projects, signage, announcements, decorations, and party favors.
description: We aim to bring the most stylish and practical products to complement your home decoration Perfect Decor for your Home and Office. Our frames are sure to compliment all of your photographs and pictures, even postcards or photo-cards! Display it on your table and let your friends and family enjoy the view.
